messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "used in children and adolescents under close medical supervision and at appropriate dosage"
set: ["used in children and adolescents under close medical supervision and at appropriate dosage", "dosage should increase slowly under medical supervision", "monitor height and weight in children and adolescents regularly", "weight in children and teenagers", "tell doctor about all medical conditions and drugs used", "increase to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks for adolescents and higher-weight children", "check height and weight often in children", "based on weight especially in children and teenagers", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "dispose of used autoinjectors, infusors, and cartridges in sharps container", "do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years", "used in addition to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity", "dispose of used pens, needles, and syringes in an approved sharps container", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage", "keep out of reach of children and pets", "stop using and call doctor at once"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
